entities.title: net.icelander.utv
entities.summary: The whole Java library in one package: the typed layer, the 0.2 JSON layer, the text form, structural validation and java.time interop.
entities.purpose: Gives Java code UTV's everyday values and operations. The typed classes (CivilDate, ZonedIntent, Instant, Interval and the rest) are what callers use; each of their operations builds UTV JSON and calls the JSON-layer functions (Operations, Zones, Intervals, Iso, TextForm) through the bridge in Typed.java, so both layers give the answers the shared fixtures expect.
boundaries: Pure: no clock, host time zone, locale, network or file access, except ZoneRules.load, which reads the file the caller names, and the JDK's tz database in toZonedDateTime.
Package-private classes (Civil, Gregorian, Rational, Instants, Json, Fail, Typed, KindTable, KindRules) are internals and not part of the contract.
JSON is Jackson's JsonNode; nothing else from outside the JDK is used.
